title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Anthropometric
description: Clothes/bra/cup size, waist, hips, weight, and BMI reported or calculated at the 3-year resurvey. All 7 fields are derived or calculated, and available for every questionnaire version -- no not_on_questionnaire sentinel applies to this category, and no skip patterns exist among these independent measures.

F1SIZE.title: Clothes size now
F1SIZE.$comment: No recruitment analogue -- clothes size was not asked at recruitment. Available on every questionnaire version.

F1BRA.title: Bra size now
F1BRA.$comment: No recruitment analogue. Available on every questionnaire version.

F1CUP.title: Bra cup size now
F1CUP.$comment: No recruitment analogue. Available on every questionnaire version.

F1WST.title: Waist now
F1WST.$comment: Valid range 60-110 is source-stated. Type number (not integer) since an inches-to-cm conversion can be fractional, same reasoning as recruitment's RHEIGHT/RWGT (D017).

F1HIPS.title: Hips now
F1HIPS.$comment: Valid range 80-130 is source-stated. Type number, same reasoning as F1WST.

F1WGT.title: Weight now
F1WGT.$comment: Valid range 35-195 is source-stated (recruitment's RWGT had a narrower stated range of 35-150 -- transcribed as given, not reconciled). Type number, same reasoning as F1WST.

F1BMI.title: Body mass index
F1BMI.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-80 reuses recruitment's RBMI bound (D018) for consistency rather than re-deriving a fresh one.
